snippet.title: Laugh Track - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing "Laugh Track," a perfectly normal game in which nothing weird happens! You're now the writer of a wacky teen sitcom. Choose your scripts, decide what characters to build relationships with, and keep those audience ratings high -- or get cancelled in more ways than one! Welcome to Must See TV.
